hooks.command: for root in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" /opt/.devin/plugins_cache/cache/*shunt*/*; do if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/hooks/check-file-size" ]; then exec bash "$root/hooks/check-file-size" --harness devin; fi; done; echo 'shunt: plugin root not found' >&2

for root in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" /opt/.devin/plugins_cache/cache/*shunt*/*; do if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/hooks/check-bash-read" ]; then exec bash "$root/hooks/check-bash-read" --harness devin; fi; done; echo 'shunt: plugin root not found' >&2
